---
title: "link-external: site-url default filter"
# bd-t3n1nghb: on a website without `link-external-filter`, links under
# `website.site-url` are internal (Quarto 1's default); other absolute
# links are external. Navigation chrome is never adorned.
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['main a.external[href="https://example.org/"]']
        - [
            'a.external[href^="https://docs.example.com/"]',
            'nav a.external',
          ]
---

- [Same site, absolute](https://docs.example.com/guide/)
- [Elsewhere](https://example.org/)
